ruling70.note: Owner ruling 70 (2026-10-05): the three swiss_knockout R4 cells whose Swiss round 5 pairs nobody under the product's lots tiebreak (a UUID-hashed draw, by design) flip between works and red across runs (P6, audit SW-H1, routed to W3). The baseline records them RED whatever the committed run showed: a later works on them reads as an improvement and a later red as no change. judge regression applies this list to the baseline it is given, and only to the run it was written for (workflowRun, tag, tagCommit: the committed L3 must be that run, or the block is refused). The SW-H1 fix removes this block and re-baselines L3.
